title: GUTI reallocation completion by the network

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to indicate completion of GUTI reallocation procedure.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate GUTI reallocation procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3450
entities.description: Timer used during GUTI reallocation procedure.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identifier used to identify the UE.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list containing tracking areas where the UE can move without performing tracking area update.

entities.name: GUTI reallocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reallocating the GUTI and optionally the TAI list to the UE.

relations.description: GUTI reallocation procedure includes receiving GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message.
Receipt of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message stops timer T3450.
Upon receipt of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE, the MME considers the new GUTI as valid and old GUTI as invalid.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain a new TAI list.
If a new TAI list is provided in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND, the MME considers the new TAI list as valid and old TAI list as invalid upon receipt of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE.
